findings.location: provider candidate-outcome logging at line 501; provider malformed-path capture at CodeGraphContextProvider.cs lines 465-468 and 956-967
findings.affected_requirement: AC-7, FR-015, SC-006, T039-T040, and the bounded/redacted diagnostic contract
findings.evidence: A malformed Projection A row whose path is an absolute host path is rejected by NormalizePath, but the parser catches that row and stores TryReadPath(row, "path") verbatim as ProviderCandidateOutcome.RelativePath when it is at most 2,048 characters. The coordinator then logs outcome.RelativePath before calling NormalizeAuditPath. The durable outcome is later reduced to (unknown), but the prior LogWarning can disclose the absolute host path, contrary to the explicit no-absolute-host-path logging requirement. Existing disclosure tests use NullLogger and inspect returned/persisted text, so they do not close this logging path.
findings.correction_outcome: Normalize or replace every provider outcome path with the bounded safe Repository-relative value before any log call, and add a regression RED with a captured logger and an absolute/path-escape malformed provider row proving that logs, durable state, and responses contain neither the raw path nor any host-path fragment.
